notes: Client-side MVP: localStorage + copy/paste ChatGPT workflows only.
No OpenAI/ChatGPT API keys or network calls to LLM providers in MVP milestones.
Error-fix budget for the continue loop is 5 rounds (see AGENTS_LOOP-Continue-Milestone.md).
Each milestone lists verify.auto checks the agent must run before marking done.

milestones.name: Freeze MVP interfaces & data model
milestones.goal: Lock stack, storage schema, training stages, and verification conventions so later milestones do not thrash.
features: Document stack choice (Vite + TypeScript + vanilla)
Define versioned localStorage document schema
Define training stage enum and passage type enum
Define ChatGPT prompt-template contract (copy out / paste back)
Record cost-avoidance rules (no LLM API in MVP)
milestones.user_experience: No end-user UI yet; planning gate only.
data_stored: Decisions and schema drafts in .agents/state.json → decisions/contracts
Optional docs/DATA_MODEL.md mirroring the frozen schema
technical_considerations: Schema must support bible_reference vs custom_script without baking copyrighted text into share URLs
All IDs should be stable UUID/string keys for passages and attempts
milestones.cost_avoidance: Explicit ban on LLM provider SDKs/API keys for MVP
deliverables: docs/DATA_MODEL.md with Passage, Segment, ReductionLevels, VisualAnchor, Attempt, ScoreboardEntry, Settings
scripts/verify-m0.mjs (or .agents/skills/verify-m0) that checks required decision keys exist
acceptance: state.json records stack, storage key name, schema version, stage list, passage types
DATA_MODEL.md exists and matches frozen contracts
verify.auto for M0 returns PASS
No application runtime code required beyond verify script
